dateline: Mexico City — ARIRANG Tour Night 2 at Estadio GNP Seguros; SWIM Enters 7th Consecutive Week on Billboard Hot 100
heroHeadline: Day 4,713: BTS Night 2 in Mexico City — ARIRANG Tour Continues at Estadio GNP Seguros; 'SWIM' Marks 7th Chart Week
heroSubtitle: May 9, 2026 is Day 4,713 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS performs Night 2 of their historic three-night Mexico City run at Estadio GNP Seguros (8:00 PM local), drawing 45,000+ fans in the 360-degree in-the-round stage — part of 136,000+ expected across the full Latin leg. 'Airplane pt.2,' which references Mexico City by name, debuted as a rotating surprise song for this night, generating enormous crowd response. Billboard's Mexico City multi-night recap describes the GNP Seguros run as 'the biggest K-pop event ever staged in Latin America.' Simultaneously, 'SWIM' enters its 7th consecutive week on the Billboard Hot 100 and ARIRANG remains in the Top 5 of the Billboard 200 for a 7th straight week — both K-pop records. The Ticketmaster México–Profeco controversy from Night 1 continued to generate coverage, with ARMY México issuing updated entry guidance that helped reduce access problems for Night 2. Night 3 follows on May 10, then the ARIRANG World Tour advances to Las Vegas (Allegiant Stadium, May 23–28).
